question: Who among the following is the author of the book ‘Unfinished: A Memoir’?
solution:
The correct answer is __Unfinished__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The memoir titled ‘Unfinished’ is written by Bollywood actress Priyanka Chopra Jonas.
 
• With the release of her first novel, "Unfinished: A Memoir," which she described as "honest, raw and vulnerable," actor-producer Priyanka Chopra Jonas officially became an author.
 
• The end result is a book published by the imprint of Michael Joseph that covers her 20-year dual-continental career as an actor and producer and her role as a Goodwill Ambassador for UNICEF.
 
• The memoir promises to offer insights into the childhood of Priyanka Chopra Jonas in India and her formative adolescent years in the US.
 
• Against all odds, her return to India resulted in the newcomer to the pageant world winning Miss India and Miss World national and international beauty competitions that launched her global acting career.
